messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT [sev2] GPU_POOL_PRESSURE — us-west-2. Autoscaler returning quotaExceeded on node create; elevated 429s to inference API. Paging oncall: @sahil @lina. https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1778000001

sahil: on it. seeing many preemptions in g4dn. autoscaler logs: ```2026-03-16T09:12:01Z error createNode: quotaExceeded: "quota exceeded for GPU"``` Investigating quota + spot reclaim rates.

lina: noted. can we shift non-urgent traffic to eu-west-1? I can trigger partial routing if we have capacity.

sahil: doing gradual shift: `rbctl route update inference --from=us-west-2 --to=eu-west-1 --percent=25` — monitoring.

maria: support reports ~4 customers with increased error rates, ticket IDs: 2345,2347,2350. Notified CSMs.

jordan: oncall takeover in 20m — i'll take bridge in 15. @sahil handoff when you have initial mitigation.

sahil: handing off — initial mitigation: increased pool size + routing shift started. added temporary pool `burst-usw-2` (manual). autoscaler still throwing quota errors but new pool created via reservation.

jordan: acknowledged. scheduling postmortem: Fri 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Owner: @lina. Prep: timeline + perf graphs + autoscaler logs. Invite list: eng-infra, eng-runtime, support, sales.

lina: action items:
- collect autoscaler logs + quota error stack
- evaluate fallback routing policy to default 30% across similar regions
- confirm spot preemption thresholds and review instance types
- update runbook with faster manual pool creation steps

maria: I'll own customer comms follow-up (ASAP). tagging support-bot to create summary.

support-bot: Created incident summary ticket INC-20260316-1778000001 in backlog. Assigned to maria, priority P2.

jordan: putting a short checklist for owner to track and close actions: `owner, due_date, status` — please update the INC ticket.

sahil: short-term resolution looks stable: 429s down to 2% after shifting 25%. continuing monitoring for 2 hrs.

lina: added preliminary RCA notes to doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/incident-1778000001 (draft). Will fill in before postmortem.

opsbot: INCIDENT update — severity downgraded to P3. Please follow postmortem schedule and close action items by next Wed.

jordan: thanks team. we'll reconvene Fri. :white_check_mark:
